scenicChapters.title: Glenorchy Lake Road photo pull-off → Glenorchy Lake Road checkpoint 8

places-los-grajos-ii-l-tello-i-cama-del-.story: 255 km from Cieza to Cieza, about 4 h 24 of riding. On the way it passes Cueva de la Plata, L. Tello I. Cama del Pastor and back through Cueva de la Plata. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
